notes.title: Exciting News and a Big Thank You!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I’m thrilled to share an update with you all. Since the release of The Neon Mate, my very first commercial project, I’ve been hard at work on a brand-new game titled Notmads, which is set to release next year! 🎉

The Neon Mate was an incredible journey—a project where I learned so much about game development and had the amazing opportunity to connect with all of you. Your support has meant the world to me, and I can’t thank you enough for giving the game a chance and being part of this adventure.

As I move forward, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938100/Notmads/]Notmads [/url]takes a completely different direction in both style and gameplay. This new project is much closer to the kind of games I love the most, and I think it’s going to be something really special. While it’s quite different from The Neon Mate, I’d love for you to check it out when it’s released—it might just be your next favorite!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938100/Notmads/

Rhomita
